$comment: Evidence-based recipe draft. Fields added only after MCP confirmation from Delivery Template Draft File (CAL87CQlzeFN0T3dtrkm24). See FIGMA_FIGJAM_MATRIX.md for provenance.
label: Product Design Delivery File
description: Full delivery file for a product design project. Matches the AT&T App Design delivery file template.

cover.$comment: Two cover types exist in the template. This section covers the DELIVERY file cover (node 1:185, on-canvas). The Design Library Cover variant (node 2245:9324, off-canvas) uses a separate 6-value status enum — see $libraryCover below.

fileName.label: File name
fileName.placeholder: Feature in Plain English and no longer than 2 lines

description.label: Description
description.placeholder: Brief statement to give context to feature/flow and allow greater understanding of what is in this file

constraints.$comment: How-to doc (2163:39095) said 2 lines; actual component placeholder (1:185) says Max 3 lines — 3 lines is canonical.

fileStatus.$comment: Workflow/handoff stage badge rendered on the cover thumbnail. Confirmed from node 2163:39095 (How to use covers doc) and node 1:185 (visual: emoji + colored text pill, e.g. 🚧 Design In Progress).
fileStatus.label: File status

allowedValues.label: In Progress
allowedValues.description: Design is working and this file is not ready for development.

allowedValues.label: Ready for Dev
allowedValues.description: Design has been approved and is marked Ready for Dev.

allowedValues.label: Under Review
allowedValues.description: When external reviews are triggered - Legal, Brand, etc.

allowedValues.label: Launched
allowedValues.description: Designs are in production. Update Master files as appropriate.

allowedValues.label: Outdated / Archive
allowedValues.description: Deprecated. Look to Master or updated designs which might be in progress.

allowedValues.label: Hold
allowedValues.description: Project is on hold. Follow the iTrack link in file for more details.

allowedValues.label: Discovery
allowedValues.description: Early discovery work not yet in the production pipeline.

allowedValues.label: Dev in Progress
allowedValues.description: Actively in development. Designers and developers in active demos, reviews, and VQA.

isMasterFile.$comment: Confirmed from node 2163:39095. Master files maintain the broader user journey; not used for delivery.
isMasterFile.label: Master file

showStatus.$comment: Toggle to show/hide fileStatus badge on the cover. Confirmed from node 2163:39095.
showStatus.label: Show status

collaborators.$comment: 6 fixed discipline slots confirmed from node 1:185 (bottom strip of cover thumbnail). Each slot: discipline label (medium) + collaborator name (bold). Background: rgba(0,159,219,0.2) AT&T blue tint.
collaborators.label: Collaborators

$libraryCover.$comment: Design Library Cover variant (node 2245:9324, off-canvas at -1985,-2958). Separate from delivery cover. Used for design library files, not delivery files. Needs its own recipe file or a coverType discriminator.

vqa.$comment: Confirmed from node 2550:2071 (blank template) and 2545:9111 (filled example: 'Dashboard FAQ accordion section', designer Bryan B, developer Noa). Each experience is a Figma section named 'VQA - [name]'.

reviewContexts.label: Review contexts
reviewContexts.note: Viewport/theme column labels. Not a fixed enum — designer adds relevant contexts per experience.

designFrames.label: Design frames
designFrames.placeholder: Your representative designs here for 1:1 comparison of issues
designFrames.note: One iPhone 13 & 14 frame per review context. Left side of VQA layout.

devFrames.label: Dev build frames
devFrames.placeholder: Dev provided screen or Design captured from test build
devFrames.note: One iPhone 13 & 14 frame per review context. Right side of VQA layout. Named '(same as delivered)'.

callouts.label: VQA callouts
callouts.note: Callout/VQA annotation instances in middle zone between design and dev columns.

final.$comment: Prototype page is currently empty by template intent (user confirmed). Dev Hand Off page confirmed from section 2164:51795 ('Delivery Hand Off - MM.DD.YYYY') with child instances 2164:51796 (Section Header) and 2164:51797 (Components in use).

prototype.$comment: Capture-mode decision: prototype page exists in FINAL but starts empty in template. Do not scaffold starter nodes here by default.

devHandOff.$comment: Screenshot-confirmed structure. The top header is the actual content scaffold; the Components in use panel is a helper block for developer estimation and component inventory.

disciplineStatuses.$comment: Section-header status chips. These align with FigJam Frame 3 guidance about approval tracking and engaged-team signals.

componentsInUse.$comment: Helper block, not core page metadata. Used as a developer estimation helper and component inventory.

instructions.note: Three instruction groups are shown: Feature Designer, Development Team, Reference.

projectResources.$comment: Confirmed from single-node instance 8:296 ('About this project') under Project Resources. This appears to be a reusable structured intake/reference page scaffold.

outOfScope.label: Out of scope
outOfScope.placeholder: relevant and related work that is specifically called out as not in scope for this effort.

description.placeholder: [Link name or description Example: old reference file, a team FigJam, research readouts]

notes.label: Notes
notes.placeholder: Write any extra notes here along the way
